info.title: catalyrst-places
info.description: Rust port of decentraland/places (REST API for places.decentraland.org), federation-aware via catalyrst-fed. Unknown routes under /api answer `{"ok":false,"error":"NotFound","code":"not_found"}` (404), as do known paths with another method.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Count places (`places`), worlds (`worlds`) or both (any other value or absent).

get.description: Every active category in table order with its count (zero when no place carries it), counted over every place row, disabled included; `target=places|worlds` narrows the count (places `Category/routes.ts`, `Category/model.ts:34-51`).

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: like_score (default) | most_active | updated_at | created_at; any other value (user_visits included) orders by like_score (the `oneOf` fallback, Destination/model.ts:189-195). most_active is the one ordering where the current user count outranks highlighted, so a busy uncurated destination lists above an empty featured one

parameters.name: with
parameters.description: Comma-separated decorations: live_events, connected_users, realms_detail. `next_event` is read on `/v1/destinations` only.

parameters.name: with_connected_users
parameters.description: True to add connected_addresses to each destination: an array of the connected wallet addresses (empty when nobody is connected), or null when comms-gatekeeper could not be reached

400.description: Validation failed: 400 with `data.errors`, `data.messages` and the validated `data.body`

get.description: The destinations feed (`Destination/routes/getDestinationsList.ts`): the union of enabled genesis places and listed catalogue worlds, or one of them with `only_places` (which wins over `only_worlds`, Destination/model.ts:234). World rows carry `base_position` `0,0`, empty `positions` and the latest enabled scene's contact, creator and sdk (:39-49). `names` is a case-insensitive substring match with `%` and `_` taken literally; `world_names` exact. dcl-one adds `positions` (alias of `pointer`), `ids`, `kinds`, `only_sdk7` and `with=`; `next_event` appears only when `with=next_event` asks for it.

400.description: Validation failed: 400 with `data.errors`, `data.messages` and the validated `data.body`

post.description: The feed over an array of destination ids (`getDestinationsListById.ts`), under the same query parameters as GET; more than 100 ids answer 400 and so does any body that is not an array (an object of selectors is `POST /v1/destinations`'); an empty array selects nothing and lists the generic feed. The `with=next_event` decoration and the `kind`/`live_event`/`next_event` keys are `/v1/destinations`' only.

put.summary: Replace the whole automated ranking set in one transaction.
put.description:
The payload is the complete set for a run: every ranking it names is
written, and every automated ranking it does not name is cleared, but only
for the types the run declares in `replaces` (absent that, the types its
entries carry). Curated destinations are never touched, not by the write
and not by the clear, for both callers -- this route captures no token
identity, so the admin bearer buys no override here the way it does on the
single-destination routes.

Answers 400 when the body is malformed (including a `replaces` that is not
an array of unique "place"/"world" items), when a destination appears more
than once, when an entry's type is outside `replaces`, or when every
destination sent for one type is unknown, which would clear that type's
rankings rather than replace them.

requestBody.description: { replaces?: ("place"|"world")[] | null, entries: [{ entity_type: "place"|"world", id: string, ranking: number }] }. replaces is optional and nullable, holds at most 2 unique items, and names the types this run clears and replaces; absent or null falls back to the types the entries carry, and [] replaces nothing.

get.description: Place listing (places `Place/routes/getPlaceList.ts`). `world is false` unless `only_highlighted` or `names` (`world_id IN`) are set, which also admit world scenes (Place/model.ts:150-156). `owner` matches the row's owner or a parcel the wallet holds or operates on chain (:186-197). `search` matches and ranks the weighted `textsearch` vector with a prefix tsquery (:171,323-328) and adds `rank` to every item. `most_active` orders by the live headcounts this node observes (the old places service sorted the first hundred by hot-scene counts). `realms_detail` lists this node's realm only.

post.description: The listing over an array of place ids (`getPlaceListById.ts`): `offset`, `limit`, `order_by`, `order` and `search` apply, disabled rows are left out, `total` counts every id the table knows (Place/model.ts:579-592).

post.description: Status rows (`id`, `disabled`, `disabled_reason`, `world`, `world_name`, `base_position`) for up to 100 ids, disabled rows included (`getPlaceStatusListById.ts`); more than 100 ids answer 404.

patch.description: Sets or clears the signer's favorite of a place (UUID) or, for older clients, a world (its name). The body is validated before the signed fetch (400 `Error validating input`); an unsigned request answers 400 `Invalid Auth Chain`. Answers the favorites read before the write plus or minus one.

like.description: True likes, false dislikes, null withdraws the vote; absent stores a like

patch.description: Sets, flips or withdraws (`like: null`) the signer's vote on a place (UUID) or, for older clients, a world (its name); `{}` stores a like. Only voters with a Snapshot voting power of 100 or more weigh in `like_rate`/`like_score`.

Link.description: <canonical URL>; rel=canonical, on a found row only

get.description: The link-preview card of a place: the old places service's HTML (title, description, og:* and twitter:* tags). The canonical URL is PLACES_BASE_URL (default https://decentraland.org/places) with pathname /places/place/ and ?position=x.y (dot-separated); id is looked up only as a UUID, position through toCanonicalPosition (separators , . ; |, world limits). An unknown or malformed lookup answers the generic card whose URL is the site root plus the request path and query, without a Link header.

Link.description: <canonical URL>; rel=canonical, on a found row only

get.description: The link-preview card of a world: the old places service's HTML (title, description, og:* and twitter:* tags). The canonical URL is PLACES_BASE_URL (default https://decentraland.org/places) with pathname /places/world/ and ?name=<world name>. An unknown or malformed lookup answers the generic card whose URL is the site root plus the request path and query, without a Link header.
